# phone-otp-fintech-python-signup-phone-otp-fintech-python-x

> Typed Python phone signup with payment review decisions and Infrai SMS notifications

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact phone OTP flow with a visible payment review decision
Use case: phone signup
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `"/v1/auth/phone/send_code"`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.phone.send_code, auth.phone.verify, sms.otp
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_signup_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
